strings.root_help: Changes apply after restarting Android. Apps request root through Magisk individually; access is not granted to every app automatically. Some games may refuse to run with root enabled.
strings.root_pending: Root mode is waiting for an Android restart.
strings.root_saved: Settings saved. Restart Android to apply the root change.
strings.root_unavailable: Optional Magisk runtime is not prepared. See scripts/prepare-root-runtime.py and docs/settings-root.md. No root files have been installed automatically.
strings.advanced_abi_help: Read from the running Android image. ARM support is shown when the image advertises it; changing the ABI requires a compatible translation layer, not this switch.
strings.advanced_adb_help: Uses the Waydroid container address on port 5555. An adb client on Linux is required. Approve the computer key in Android on first connection. Turn ADB off when you finish debugging.
strings.advanced_insecure: This Android image does not enforce ADB authentication. Enabling network ADB is unavailable; disabling remains available.
strings.advanced_input_help: Android draws touch indicators and coordinates. These overlays can cover game controls. Changes apply immediately after saving and are restored when NexDroid connects to Android.
strings.advanced_unavailable: Start Android and refresh to read the settings. No values have been assumed.
strings.advanced_saved: Debugging settings applied, verified and saved.
strings.shortcut_help: Click a shortcut and press the new combination. The switch on the right enables or disables the action. Esc cancels recording. Save changes to apply.
strings.shortcut_linux_help: These shortcuts work in the focused Android window. Linux may reserve some combinations. Host shortcuts take priority over game bindings. Esc behavior is configured in Preferences. Mouse capture requires an aim control in the game profile.
strings.shortcut_defaults_pending: Defaults restored in the form. Save changes to apply.
strings.shortcut_bad_file: The shortcuts file could not be loaded. Fix the JSON or explicitly restore defaults before saving.
strings.shortcut_saved: Shortcuts saved. Changes apply now; restarting Android is not required.
strings.phone_unavailable: Read the current profile before saving. Check the helper service and refresh.
strings.phone_help: Changes the model, manufacturer, brand and product/device names reported by Android. Android version, CPU architecture, GPU and display settings stay the same.
strings.phone_restart: Changes apply after restarting the Android container. The current session keeps its model until then. Selecting the original profile restores the values saved before the first change.
strings.phone_saved: Phone profile saved. Restart Android to apply. Applications and user data are retained.
strings.about_description: A Rust desktop shell for Android apps and games on Linux through Waydroid, with an Android window, keyboard and mouse controls, and diagnostics.
strings.upstream_credit: NexDroid is based on Liwinux. Upstream authorship, Git history and the GPL license are retained.
strings.about_android_offline: Android information is unavailable. Start Android and refresh the information.
strings.audio_help: Audio and microphone choices apply to Waydroid streams through PipeWire/PulseAudio. System default follows the current default output or input.
strings.missing_audio: The selected audio device is disconnected. System default is used temporarily; your selection is retained for reconnection.
strings.camera_help: Camera changes take effect after restarting the Android container. The Android image must support external V4L2 cameras. Auto restores the original camera configuration.
strings.missing_camera: The selected camera is disconnected. Reconnect it and refresh the list. Another camera is not selected automatically.
strings.no_cameras: No accessible V4L2 cameras found. Check the connection and Linux device permissions.
strings.devices_saved: Selection saved. Audio applies to Waydroid streams; camera changes take effect after restarting the Android container.
strings.devices_apply_error: Profile saved. Some settings could not be applied.
strings.gpu_help: Auto uses the standard GPU selection. Select a dedicated GPU from the list if needed. The choice applies to the shell and embedded compositor after restarting NexDroid. Android compatibility is checked when saving.
strings.missing_gpu: The saved GPU is unavailable. Choose Auto or an available GPU.
strings.api_help: Android uses drivers from the installed image. Switching GLES/Vulkan requires a compatible backend. The information above comes from the running Android session.
strings.astc_help: The Android driver and game choose texture handling. Support is detected from the active GLES renderer extensions. Manual decoder selection is unavailable in this build.
strings.graphics_saved: GPU selection saved. Restart NexDroid to apply.
strings.number_help: Click a number to type. Enter accepts, Esc cancels. Dimensions 320–7680 px, DPI 120–640, 0 for Auto.
strings.finish_number: Press Enter to accept the number or Esc to cancel editing.
strings.display_help: Display changes take effect the next time the Android window opens. The image keeps its aspect ratio. DPI changes the size of the Android interface.
strings.display_saved: Display saved. Reopen the Android window to apply. Performance settings are retained.
strings.resource_help: Limits apply to the Android container. Auto removes limits. Reducing RAM below current usage is rejected.
strings.fps_help: The new refresh rate takes effect the next time the Android window opens. Game FPS depends on game settings and workload.
strings.vsync: VSync — window synchronization is managed by the Wayland compositor. The current GPUI does not expose a toggle.
strings.language_help: English and Russian are included. Import a JSON with id, name and strings fields to add a language. Missing translations use English. The preview changes immediately; save to keep your choice.
strings.share_clipboard_help: Copy text in the Android window to move it to Linux. To paste Linux text into Android, press Ctrl+V in the active NexDroid window.
strings.fullscreen_start_help: Applies when a new Android window opens. Configure the fullscreen shortcut in Shortcuts.
strings.escape_help: When both options are on, the first Esc releases a captured cursor; the next exits fullscreen. When a host action is disabled, Esc remains available to Android and the game. Other combinations are configured in Shortcuts. Esc always closes this settings form.
strings.screenshots_help: The Take screenshot action saves the Android picture as PNG, without the desktop toolbar or settings. Configure its combination in Shortcuts. The folder is created when needed. Changes apply after saving.
strings.preferences_saved: Preferences saved. Language, Esc behavior and screenshot folder apply now; fullscreen on start applies to the next Android window.
strings.saved: Saved. CPU and RAM applied. Refresh rate takes effect the next time the Android window opens.
strings.apply_failed: Profile saved. Could not apply CPU/RAM.
